From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo + pricing — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Olivia - great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

Recap:
- Zenlytics is focused on adding LLM-powered search and contextual summaries for enterprise customers (security logs use case).
- Primary constraints: strict data residency for EMEA customers, throughput target ~200 req/s for summaries, and tight cost targets for per-token pricing.
- Evaluation timeline: internal procurement + security review planned for late June; target pilot in July.

Deliverables I committed to:
1) Send the demo recording + slide deck (attached).
2) Share an initial pricing workbook scoped to a 3-month pilot (attached: MVP-pricing.xlsx).
3) Provide SOC2 evidence checklist and sample config for a VPC/private deployment - I can loop in our security lead if useful.

Next steps / ask:
- Can you confirm whether procurement is the blocker or if the security/compliance review is the gating item?
- Would you like us to schedule a short follow-up with procurement (30 min) next week to walk through the pricing workbook?

If it's helpful I can pull together a 1-page mutual action plan (timeline, owners, acceptance criteria) for your procurement team.

Thanks - I attached the deck and workbook.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood-demo-deck.pdf, MVP-pricing.xlsx

Hi Olivia - quick end-of-quarter check-in. Wanted to confirm whether this project is still a priority for Zenlytics heading into next quarter. A couple quick questions:

1) Has the budget/approval timeline changed? Is the procurement sign-off still expected this quarter?
2) If procurement is delayed, would a pilot contract for a reduced scope (limited seats / capped spend) help keep momentum?
3) Any blockers on the security/compliance checklist we can immediately resolve (I can loop in our security lead and share the SOC2 evidence set).

We have limited capacity for July pilots due to EOY onboarding for a couple of customers, so if this is still priority we can earmark a slot - otherwise we can plan for an early Q3 cadence. No problem either way; want to make sure we align with your timeline.

Also attaching the one-page mutual action plan I promised (linked). If you have a quick 10-15 minute slot this week I can jump on a call to align owners and next steps.

Thanks - and congrats if you made it through the quarter end!

Best,
Aditya
